description: This file is a source implementation of the RDKShell plugin for a multimedia/embedded platform, handling application lifecycle, system events, and inter-process communication via Thunder APIs. It includes class definitions for JSONRPC communication, state notifications, and client management, and contains logic for launching, activating, deactivating, and destroying plugin-based applications within the system.
